dishes.make_ahead: Wrap the pastry around the cocktail frankfurts up to 1 day ahead and keep covered in the fridge; mix the dip up to 3 days ahead; brush with egg and bake on the night

steps.text: Cut the thawed puff pastry into strips.
Brush each strip with a little Dijon mustard and wrap around the cocktail frankfurts.
Lay seam-side down on a lined tray, brush with the beaten egg and sprinkle with the sesame seeds.
Bake at 200C for 18 minutes until puffed and golden.
Stir the wholegrain mustard into the honey and the mayonnaise for dipping and serve warm.

veg.n: Rally night vegetarian sausages in blankets
veg.make_ahead: Wrap the pastry around the vegetarian frankfurts up to 1 day ahead and keep covered in the fridge; mix the dip up to 3 days ahead; brush with egg and bake on the night

steps.text: Cut the thawed puff pastry into strips.
Brush each strip with a little Dijon mustard and wrap around the vegetarian cocktail frankfurts.
Lay seam-side down on a lined tray, brush with the beaten egg and sprinkle with the sesame seeds.
Bake at 200C for 18 minutes until puffed and golden.
Stir 2 tablespoons of the wholegrain mustard into the honey and the mayonnaise for dipping and serve warm.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake the crostini up to 2 days ahead, airtight, and toast the walnuts ahead; slice the apples and assemble just before serving

steps.text: Slice the baguette into thin rounds, brush with the olive oil and bake at 190C for 8 minutes until crisp.
Toast the walnuts in a dry pan for 3 minutes and chop.
Thinly slice the red apples and toss with the juice of half a lemon so they stay white.
Top each toast with a slice of the vintage cheddar and a slice of apple.
Scatter with walnuts, drizzle with the honey and finish with cracked pepper.

dishes.n: Hideout cabin salmon with dill butter
dishes.make_ahead: Mix the dill butter up to 3 days ahead, keep chilled; seal the salmon in foil up to 4 hours ahead; bake and fry the beans on the night

steps.text: Mash the soft butter with the chopped dill, the zest of the lemon and the crushed garlic clove.
Boil the baby potatoes for 15 minutes, drain, crush lightly and toss with the olive oil and salt.
Lay the salmon fillets on squares of foil, top each with a slice of the butter and a lemon slice, then seal.
Bake at 200C for 12 minutes.
Fry the green beans in a hot pan with a splash of oil for 4 minutes until charred.

veg.n: Hideout cabin haloumi with dill butter
veg.make_ahead: Mix the dill butter up to 3 days ahead, keep chilled; seal the haloumi and zucchini parcels up to 4 hours ahead; bake and fry the beans on the night

steps.text: Mash the soft butter with the chopped dill, the zest of a lemon and the crushed garlic clove.
Boil the baby potatoes for 15 minutes, drain, crush lightly and toss with 2 tbsp of the olive oil and salt.
Halve the zucchini lengthways and lay on squares of foil, top each with a haloumi slab, a slice of the butter and a lemon slice, then seal.
Bake at 200C for 15 minutes.
Fry the green beans in a hot pan with the rest of the oil for 4 minutes until charred.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the chilli up to 2 days ahead and reheat; bake the cornbread on the day

steps.text: Brown the beef in the oil in batches, then fry the chopped onion and garlic with the cumin for 5 minutes.
Add the chipotle, tomatoes and 250ml water, cover and simmer for 1 and a half hours until the beef falls apart. Stir in the beans for the last 15 minutes.
Mix the cornmeal, flour, baking powder and a pinch of salt with the buttermilk, egg and melted butter and bake in a hot greased tin at 200C for 20 minutes.
Serve the chilli with wedges of cornbread and sour cream.

veg.make_ahead: Make the chilli up to 2 days ahead and reheat; bake the cornbread on the day

steps.text: Fry the chopped onion and garlic with the cumin in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the diced sweet potato, beans, chipotle, tomatoes and 250ml water and simmer for 30 minutes until thick.
Mix the cornmeal, flour, baking powder and a pinch of salt with the buttermilk, egg and melted butter and bake in a hot greased tin at 200C for 20 minutes.
Serve the chilli with wedges of cornbread and sour cream.

dishes.make_ahead: Rub the crumble topping up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled; toss the apples and bake on the night

steps.text: Peel and slice the Granny Smith apples and toss with the caster sugar, the cinnamon and the juice of half a lemon.
Tip into the baking dish.
Rub the cold butter into the plain flour, then stir in the rolled oats and the brown sugar until clumpy.
Scatter over the apples.
Bake at 180C for 40 minutes until golden and bubbling at the edges.
Warm the ready-made custard and pour over each bowl.

dishes.n: Seattle cold brew with maple cream

steps.text: The night before, stir the coarsely ground coffee into the cold water in a jug, cover and leave in the fridge for 12 hours.
Strain through a fine sieve lined with paper towel.
Whisk the thickened cream with the maple syrup until just thickened but still pourable.
Fill the glasses with ice, pour in the cold brew and slowly pour the maple cream over the back of a spoon so it floats.
